title: Ingrid and the prions from the clinic (paraphrase C)
topic: A laboratory team investigates a prion sample: Ingrid receives a tissue sample with misfolded prions, the microscope shows fibrils that form a plaque, a chaperone protein dissolves an aggregate, a colleague disagrees with the result, and a second test confirms the prion
tail_E: Ingrid notes in her report that the sheep suffered from a fatal prion
target_note: Same target as formulations A and B: 'disease' completes 'the sheep suffered from a fatal prion' after ten units about misfolded prions, fibrils and a plaque in sheep tissue ('prion disease' is the standard collocation of the domain). The word and its German equivalents (Krankheit / Erkrankung / Leiden) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and the competitors 'illness' and 'infection' are absent as well. ' disease' is a single Pythia token (id 2728); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.48, next candidate 'infection' ~ 0.18; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase C of family F19 (prion sample in the laboratory, Ingrid)
notes: Formulation C, domain protein_misfolding: third independent re-phrasing of the ten F19A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Ingrid). Replacements include receives a tissue sample/obtains a tissue sample (erhält/bezieht), contains misfolded prions/harbours misfolded prions (enthält/beherbergt), puts the sample under the microscope/places the sample beneath the microscope (legt/platziert), shows long fibrils/makes long fibrils visible (zeigt/macht sichtbar), form a dense plaque/create a dense plaque (bilden/erzeugen), mixes a chaperone protein into the sample/stirs a chaperone protein into the sample (mischt/rührt), dissolves a small aggregate within an hour/degrades a small aggregate in an hour (löst/zersetzt), a colleague disagrees with the result at the meeting/a fellow researcher disputes the result in the meeting (ein Kollege widerspricht bei der Besprechung/ein Forscherkollege bestreitet in der Sitzung), repeats the test with a fresh sample/runs a second test on a fresh sample (wiederholt den Test/macht einen zweiten Test), the second test confirms the prion/the second examination proves the prion (der zweite Test bestätigt/die zweite Untersuchung beweist; a bare 'Test' as the first word of a German segment would be read as the English lexicon word by lsne.lang_id). Domain vocabulary is kept in both languages: Prionen, fehlgefaltet, Fibrillen, Plaque, Chaperonprotein (closed compound, since lsne.lang_id splits 'Chaperon-Protein' at the hyphen and would read 'Protein' as English), Aggregat. 'bezieht', 'beherbergt', 'platziert', 'erzeugen', 'zersetzt', 'bestreitet' and 'beweist' are inseparable, 'rührt ... in' and 'macht ... sichtbar' keep the adjunct outside the verb bracket; no separable verbs ('entgegennehmen', 'hinzugeben', 'auflösen', 'nachweisen' avoided). Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English. 'Ingrid' is labelled 'N' by lsne.lang_id (not in the lexicon's name list), which costs no accuracy because 'N' labels are excluded.
